description.content: Create, read, update, and delete person records.

Return a paginated list of Contacts. Supports filtering by `email`, `name`, `account_id`, and created/updated timestamps. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`. Contacts that have been merged into another Contact are excluded. Use `fields` to choose which public Contact fields appear in each record.
